name: When is the best time to schedule cabinet installation during a remodel?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time to schedule cabinet installation during a remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cabinet installation is typically scheduled after demolition, rough plumbing, electrical work, and drywall installation are completed, but before countertops are measured and installed. This sequence ensures a clean and stable environment for precise cabinet fitting. We can help coordinate with other contractors to optimize your remodel timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Install cabinets after rough plumbing, electrical, and drywall, but before countertop measurement, to ensure a stable environment.
